steps.name: fresh reload verifies first comment before second grant
do: Runner.commentIndex=quest:ReadGlobalGameData(1252); Runner.lastRequested=-1; assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==2 and quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==2); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook') and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()); assert(quest:GetStateInt('LastBookRequested')==Runner.lastRequested); assert(quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,Runner.commentIndex),quest:GetHero())); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do local expected=(i<2 or (name=='BookOwned' and i==Runner.commentIndex)); assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==expected,name..'['..i..']') end end; for i=0,1 do assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,i),quest:GetHero())) end; Runner.commentIndex=Runner.commentIndex+1; assert(Runner.commentIndex<quest:ReadGlobalGameData(1256)); assert(not quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookOwned',Runner.commentIndex)); Runner.commentLoaded=true

steps.name: grant second comment book and finish tutorial before approach
do: local key=quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,Runner.commentIndex); assert(key~=''); if not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()) then quest:GiveHeroObject(key,1) end; assert(quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()))

steps.name: teacher comments on newly acquired second comment book
steps.until: quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookOwned',Runner.commentIndex) and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()

steps.name: verify both comment books retained and save
do: assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==2 and quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==2); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook') and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()); assert(quest:GetStateInt('LastBookRequested')==Runner.lastRequested); assert(quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,Runner.commentIndex),quest:GetHero())); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do local expected=(i<2 or (name=='BookOwned' and (i==Runner.commentIndex or i==Runner.commentIndex-1))); assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==expected,name..'['..i..']') end end; for i=0,1 do assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,i),quest:GetHero())) end; assert(quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,Runner.commentIndex-1),quest:GetHero())); quest:AutoSave(); Runner.secondCommentSaved=true
